chibi-dinosaur-monument-conqueror.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DINOSAUR:CONQUEROR
chibi-dinosaur-monument-conqueror.notes: Candidate 10 of 16: a small arch of three dark basalt stones (two standing stones and a lintel) with an open gateway, a ring wreath of green fern leaves on the lintel and a crossed stone spear and bone club on its front; the Conqueror's arch and wreath as a Dinosaur trilithon, lit from the left. 2, 6 and 8 have a wreath of orange feathers that reads as a flower; 3, 4, 5, 9 and 13 mossy olive stone; 0 and 1 a grass tuft, not a wreath.

chibi-dinosaur-monument-engineer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DINOSAUR:ENGINEER
chibi-dinosaur-monument-engineer.notes: Candidate 12 of 16: a square basalt pillar under a big grey stone cogwheel standing on its edge, a crossed bone pick and wooden stone hammer lashed with green vine and two orange feathers on its front; the Engineer's cog and crossed tools in Dinosaur stone. The sixteen are near twins; 0 to 2 and 4 have no feathers, 5 a dimmer pick.

chibi-dinosaur-monument-explorer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DINOSAUR:EXPLORER
chibi-dinosaur-monument-explorer.notes: Candidate 5 of 16: a dark basalt standing stone with a big cream compass rose carved on its front, a tuft of orange feathers on its tip, a bone spyglass and green vine at its foot; the Explorer's compass and spyglass in Dinosaur stone and bone. 10 and 13 are close (10 has stray pixels under it, 13 a smaller spyglass); 0 and 4 a tusk instead of a spyglass; 2 and 9 a stepped pillar, not a standing stone; 3 and 14 small roses.

chibi-dinosaur-monument-land-baron.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DINOSAUR:LAND_BARON
chibi-dinosaur-monument-land-baron.notes: Candidate 6 of 16: a stout dark basalt boundary stone with a carved shield bearing a dinosaur skull, a crown of cream tusks on its top, a signpost of two wooden arrow boards on lashed sticks, green vine and an orange feather; the Land Baron's crowned boundary stone and signpost in Dinosaur stone and tusk. The sixteen are near twins; 3, 7 and 15 lose the signpost boards. The faces measure reads -2.1 (dark basalt counts as outline); the front face is the lit one.

chibi-dinosaur-monument-muster.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DINOSAUR:MUSTER
chibi-dinosaur-monument-muster.notes: Candidate 12 of 16: a square basalt pillar with a curved cream tusk horn across its top, a turtle-shell shield, a spotted hide shield and two more at its back, tied on with green vine, and a tuft of orange feathers; the Muster's trophy of shields under a horn in Dinosaur shell, hide and bone. All sixteen share the plan; 1, 5, 9 and 13 have no turtle shell, 3, 11 and 15 mossy green shields that sink into the grass. The faces measure reads -3.0 (the dark basalt is mostly outline-dark, so the pale shields weigh in); the pillar's left face is the lit one.
